decisions.reason: The track spotlight has had its own page for two consecutive years, which signals a sustained commitment. It fits the modular system portfolio, so keeping it costs little relative to the value of the option.
The ceiling luminaire has been featured continuously since 2023, which suggests acceptable early results. There is no evidence that would justify abandoning it.
Launched only in 2024, the flexible spotlight still carries uncertain but promising prospects. It complements the system range, so the option is worth keeping open.
The multi-outlet canopy is a low-cost system accessory that supports sales of other luminaires. Keeping this option preserves flexibility for very little expense.
The low-voltage canopy variant is cheap to keep within the modular system. It is too new to judge, so abandoning it would be premature.

The glass track luminaires are only mentioned on the website, which signals weaker commitment. Their value is still unresolved after a single year and holding them costs little, so the option stays open for now.
